limitations: Nine successful checks refer to the full PR head observed above and must be rechecked if that head changes.
The 362-source manifest covers the recorded public Android build, generator, test and policy inputs; it does not claim every repository path or private configuration was validated.

The successful CodeQL scanning check reports no new alerts in changed code and zero finding annotations. The separate lowercase workflow job has four infrastructure annotations, including the GitHub diff-size limit, which are preserved rather than reported as zero.
Both optional FCM variants compile in CI; this proves neither real Firebase configuration nor push delivery.
GitHub deployments were queried using the full head SHA and returned an empty list at the observed time; this is not a global audit of deployments outside that SHA or provider.

Physical-device behavior, signed runtime, account, payments, provider delivery, Google Play acceptance and distribution have their own evidence. This CI monitor did not operate devices or initiate any release.
